messages.text: The Hammer Miner DC08 is now in stock? Just want to confirm as it wasnt as of a week ago
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC08
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Scrypt DC

Yes, the Hammer Miner DC08 is live and in stock right now. 480 MH/s on Scrypt at about 137W, $539, US/EU plug matched to your address. In-stock units ship within about 5 business days.

Here it is: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-dc08

If you want more Scrypt on the bench, there's also a DC06 + DC08 pack at $799.99 for 810 MH/s combined. Want me to build the cart for either?
Question about shipping. Is overnight shipping available? I dont want a $500 miner sitting outside my door while im at work

I can't promise overnight from here. The carrier options and prices show at checkout once your address is in, and that's where you'd see if an expedited service is offered for your area.

Two things that solve the doorstep worry regardless of speed: put your work address in as the shipping address, or sign up with the carrier (UPS My Choice, FedEx Delivery Manager) and reroute or hold it for pickup once the tracking lands.

Where are you shipping to? I'll check what we can offer for that address.
Address is: (address hidden)
Made a checkout link

Honest answer: I can't confirm an overnight service for (address hidden) from here. The carrier choices and prices appear at checkout once your address and phone are in, and that's the real list.

Worth knowing either way: in-stock units leave our US warehouse within about 5 business days, so an overnight carrier only speeds the last leg, not the pick and pack.

I've built the DC08 cart with your address ready: ····

Add the phone there and you'll see every option.
Ok I understand. Regardless of when I place the order im getting it from heliumdeploy you guys seem to be the "go to" on miners, thank you.
Used the chat-interview skill

Appreciate that, honestly. The cart stays live if you want it, and the DC08 is on the shelf now.

Before you go, one thing: what's holding you back from ordering today, the delivery worry or something else?
This would be my first miner, so im doing lots of research to make sure I get the right one

That makes sense for a first one.

What's pulling you toward Scrypt, the Doge and Litecoin side, rather than a Bitcoin unit?
Its not about the money its more about the chances of hitting a block in a reasonable amount of time.

Then you're on the right chain. Solo Bitcoin from a small home unit is a very long shot; Scrypt is much friendlier because Doge and Litecoin blocks come about once a minute and the network hashrate behind them is smaller.

For scale, our DC02 page puts a 105 MH/s unit at roughly 1 in 21,000 a day. The D.08 is 480 MH/s, so several times that chance, and you get Doge plus merge-mined coins on the same work.

Want me to check what else we stock on Scrypt above 480 MH/s?
Yes thats what I have concluded. Even some of the smaller coins that are easier, part of it is just wanting to get my feet wet and the satisfaction of solving a block
Searched the catalog · Scrypt Dogecoin Litecoin miner MH/s

On Scrypt above 480 MH/s we stock three routes, all in stock:

DOGE TRIO PACK, three DC06 for $760, 990 MH/s total, three separate shots at a block.
DOGE DUO PACK, DC06 + DC08, $799.99, 810 MH/s across two machines.
Harlo H15 Dual, $999, 1.08 GH/s Scrypt and 15 TH/s on Bitcoin at once, about 500W.

For a first unit and pure block-hunting fun, the Trio spreads your luck widest. Want the links or a cart for any of them?
I saw the Trio and its tempting. Im still debating on the trio or a single dc08. Also have to factor in if my internet can handle the workload

Internet is the easy part. A miner sends tiny stratum packets, kilobits per second, so three of them put less load on your line than a single video call. What matters is a stable connection, not speed. Wired beats WiFi if you can reach them.

On the choice: the Trio gives you 990 MH/s and three independent lottery tickets for $760, against 480 MH/s for $539. More chances, but 315W and three boxes of fan noise. One honest catch: the DC06 is final sale, so the Trio isn't returnable.
Ouch, no return policy if I get a dead one or one dies prematurely is scary.

Fair worry, but final sale and faulty are two different things. Final sale means no change-of-mind returns. A unit that arrives dead or fails is a warranty case, and those go through our RMA process: you fill the form, we send a return label, and we replace or settle it.

I won't quote you a warranty length off the cuff, I'd rather confirm the exact terms for that model than guess.

RMA form, so you can see it: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Want me to get you the warranty terms in writing?
Hmmm yes sure. Im still debating between the trio  and the dc08, its a toss up at this point
Handed to the team · warranty terms not something I quote; customer wants them in writing before buyi

Georges has it and will come back here with the warranty terms in writing. Stay in the chat if you can; if you step away it comes to your email.

On the toss-up, one way to cut it: the Trio is the better buy on odds and price per MH, the DC08 is the safer first step, one box, 137W, and it stands alone as a returnable product. If this is your feet-wet unit, start with the DC08 and add later. You'll know how it all behaves before you triple it.
Atleast with the trio I could solo mine with 2 and pool mine with the other

That's a genuinely good reason to go Trio. Each unit points at its own pool independently, so two can solo hunt Doge or a smaller Scrypt coin while the third drips steady payouts from a pool. You learn both sides at once, and you can swap any unit between them anytime.

Three boxes, about 315W, and you'd want three outlets and a shelf with airflow.

Want me to build the Trio cart with your address so it's ready when Georges comes back on the warranty?
No you don't have to do that, im making my final decision over the weekend, are there plenty of the trios in stock?
Looked something up in Shopify

Yes, plenty. We're showing 14 Trio packs ready to go, with 44 DC06 units on the shelf behind them. No rush on the weekend.

Take your time, and Georges will have those warranty terms to you either here or by email.
Awesome thank you so mich

Any time, glad to help. Whichever way you land, you're going in with the right expectations, which is more than most first buyers.

If you want other people's real-world take while you decide, our Discord is worth a look: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Plenty of Scrypt solo miners in there, and JD, our technical guy, is active.

Good luck this weekend.
Awesome thank you so much!
You're welcome, Charlie. Enjoy the research, and shout if anything else comes up before you decide.
Will do!
Sounds good. Have a good weekend, Charlie.
